title: Designers Have a New User. And It Is Not a Human
h1: Designers Have a New User. And It Is Not a Human

cover.alt: A designer, a human user, and an AI agent connected through a shared flow of data, rules, and tools

tldr: For the last twenty years, we mostly designed for a person in front of a screen. Now products have another participant: an AI agent that reads data, calls tools, and runs multi-step workflows across systems. Human interfaces are not going away, but a second object of design is emerging alongside them: the environment, contracts, boundaries, and rules in which an agent operates.
